claims.evidence: Model number not visible in the photo; spec cannot be confirmed without identifying the exact model.
No way to confirm burst rate from a static rear-view photo; depends on exact model.

claims.claim: 1080p HD video recording with manual control
claims.evidence: Not demonstrable from a still photo; would need a video sample or menu screenshot.
No shutter-count screenshot or EXIF data shown; photo only shows exterior rear view.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens is attached or shown in the photo at all.
Battery and charger are not visible in the photo.
No internal or service-tag evidence available from an exterior photo.

risks.risk: Exact camera model unknown, which affects base value tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model name/number on the body (top plate or front) or a photo of the lens mount area
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value plausible Canon APS-C DSLR model matching the described feature set

risks.risk: Shutter count unverified, could be much higher than claimed
risks.proof: Screenshot from shutter-count checking software or EOS utility showing actuations

risks.risk: No lens included or lens condition unknown (fungus, scratches, haze)
risks.proof: Photo of the lens glass (front and rear elements) and mount, ideally against light
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only, no lens included

risks.risk: Physical damage to front, sides, or screen not visible in the single rear photo
risks.proof: Photos of front, both sides, bottom, and a close-up of the LCD screen
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

risks.risk: Battery, charger, memory card, strap not confirmed present
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Functional status (powers on, autofocus, sensor dust/spots) unconfirmed
risks.proof: Video clip of camera powering on, taking a shot, and displaying it on screen
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested/for-parts risk until functionality is shown

risks.risk: Repair history claim cannot be verified remotely
risks.proof: Photo of screws/seals for tamper evidence, or service receipt if available
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified repair history, no premium for 'never repaired' claim

proof_requests: Photo of the model name/number on the camera body
Photo of the lens (if included) showing front and rear glass elements
Photo of front, sides, bottom, and close-up of LCD screen
Screenshot of shutter count from software or camera menu
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, card, strap) together
Short video of the camera powering on and taking a test photo
response.reason: The witness confirms a Canon DSLR body only; all seller performance, condition, and inclusion claims are unverifiable from the single rear-view photo, so the item must be priced at worst case (unknown model, high shutter use, no lens, no accessories, unverified function) pending further proof.
